Package index

Package

openac openac-package
openac: Open Affective Computing Tools

Program management

Locate, register, check and install the external command-line tools openac drives. Locations are discovered on the PATH or recorded per tool; nothing is hard-coded.

find_program() find_ffmpeg() find_ffprobe() find_openface() find_opensmile()
Find the location of a dependency program
set_program() set_ffmpeg() set_ffprobe() set_openface() set_opensmile()
Set the location of a dependency program
check_ffmpeg()
Check that ffmpeg is accessible
check_ffprobe()
Check that ffprobe is accessible
check_openface()
Check that openface is accessible
check_opensmile()
Check that opensmile is accessible
install_ffmpeg_win()
Install FFmpeg on Windows
install_openface_win()
Install openface on Windows
install_opensmile_mac()
Install openSMILE on macOS
install_opensmile_win()
Install openSMILE on Windows
install_whisper()
Install audio.whisper package

ffmpeg and ffprobe

Low-level argument passthroughs for media transcoding and probing, plus the stream count openac’s own guards rely on.

ffmpeg() ffm()
Low-level access to the ffmpeg command line interface
ffprobe() ffp()
Low-level access to the ffprobe command line interface
ffp_count_streams()
Count the streams in a media file

OpenFace

Facial-behavior feature extraction, per file and per directory.

openface() of()
Low-level access to the openface command line interface
of_extract()
Extract openface features
of_extract_dir()
Run of_extract() on multiple files in a directory

openSMILE

Acoustic feature extraction — config discovery, audio preparation, and extraction per file and per directory.

opensmile() os()
Low-level access to the opensmile command line interface
os_list_configs()
List openSMILE configuration files
os_check_config()
Resolve an openSMILE config name to an absolute path
os_check_audio()
Check if an audio file is ready for analysis by openSMILE
os_prep_audio()
Prepare an audio stream for analysis by opensmile
os_prep_audio_dir()
Run os_prep_audio() on multiple files in a directory
os_extract()
Extract opensmile features
os_extract_dir()
Run os_extract() on multiple files in a directory

whisper

Speech transcription via audio.whisper — audio preparation, model fetch, and transcription per file and per directory.

aw_check_audio()
Check if an audio file is ready for analysis by Whisper
aw_prep_audio()
Prepare an audio stream for analysis by Whisper
aw_prep_audio_dir()
Run aw_prep_audio() on multiple files in a directory
aw_get_model()
Get a Whisper model from a local or online source
aw_transcribe()
Transcribe an audio stream using the specified Whisper model
aw_transcribe_dir()
Transcribe multiple media files with Whisper

Tidy readers

Turn one tool’s raw output into a tidy tibble under one shared contract. Each reader states its row grain in its first sentence.

os_read()
Read openSMILE output into a tidy tibble
of_read()
Read OpenFace output into a tidy tibble
aw_read()
Read a Whisper transcription into a tidy tibble

Parallelism and progress

Re-exported controls so batch runs can be configured without attaching the upstream packages.

plan
Re-export the plan function from the future package
handlers
Re-export the handlers function from the progressr package
